description: Add and remove labels on threads or messages. In Gmail these ARE the everyday actions: archive = remove INBOX; mark read = remove UNREAD (unread = add it); star = add STARRED; important = IMPORTANT. Labels may be given by id or by name, case-insensitively. For threads, ids that failed are listed under `failed` beside the ones changed.

account.description: Which mailbox this writes to or sends from: a label from list_accounts. Required; there is no default for writes.

ids.description: Thread or message ids, per `target`, from this account.

target.description: Act on whole threads (default, what Gmail's own buttons do) or on single messages.

name: modify_labels
title: Modify labels
